## What this changes

Adds my member card.

## Before asking for a review

- [ ] My card is at `members/<my-github-username>.md`
- [ ] All three fields are filled in, with no `<angle brackets>` left over
- [ ] I picked one role rather than leaving all three
- [ ] I requested **Zane** or **Brigid** as a reviewer (right-hand sidebar, "Reviewers")

Red X on the check below? Click **Details** on it. The message says what to fix.
